metadata.gitb:name: Upload a CDA to DDS and check it appears in your system
metadata.gitb:description: Provide a CDA (file or pasted contents) and it is uploaded to DDS (ITI-41) using metadata read from the CDA. You then upload a screenshot showing that your system found and displayed the document. A final optional step marks the document as deprecated (ITI-57).

interact.instruct: "Upload a CDA file, or paste its contents in the second field. The registry defaults to DDS TEST2. The document is stored in the chosen DDS test environment for the test patient named in the CDA (recordTarget CPR) and stays there until it is deprecated, so use a document built for testing. The next step shows the metadata read from your CDA before anything is sent. DDS refuses a document whose unique ID is already registered, so each upload needs a CDA with a new document ID."

then.log: "XDS-INPUT: " || $selectedRegistry || " is a Stamkort registry, which generates its documents. Choose a DDS registry."

exit.desc: Stopped: Stamkort registries cannot receive uploads

process.desc: Read the metadata from the CDA

exit.desc: Stopped: the CDA cannot be uploaded

steps.log: "CDA read: document " || $xdsPrepare{uploadId} || " for patient " || $xdsPrepare{uploadPatient} || ", type " || $xdsPrepare{uploadType} || ", " || $xdsPrepare{uploadSize} || ", title " || $xdsPrepare{uploadTitle} || "."

interact.instruct: "These are the values read from your CDA, which will be uploaded to DDS and registered for the patient. Choose the signing identity (a system certificate is preselected when one is configured) and the XDS format code that describes the document, then continue. Class, facility and practice-setting codes come from the service configuration; they are not taken from the CDA."

exit.desc: Stopped: DDS did not accept the upload

steps.log: "DDS accepted the upload (ITI-41): document " || $xdsSubmit{submittedUniqueId} || " for patient " || $xdsSubmit{patientId} || ", entry UUID " || $xdsSubmit{submittedEntryUuid} || ". Registry warnings: " || $xdsSubmit{submittedWarnings} || "."

interact.inputTitle: Show that your system found the CDA
interact.instruct: "DDS accepted the document. Now open it in your own system, searching as the patient from the CDA, and upload a screenshot that shows the system found and displayed it. The screenshot is kept with this test session as evidence; this test does not inspect it."

"Optionally mark the uploaded document as deprecated (ITI-57), so it no longer appears in searches for Approved documents. A deprecated document stays in the registry and cannot be uploaded again with the same ID."

request.name: choice
request.options: Deprecate the uploaded document,Leave the document approved
request.optionLabels: Deprecate the uploaded document,Leave the document approved

exit.desc: Stopped: the document could not be deprecated

then.log: "DDS accepted the deprecation (ITI-57): document " || $xdsDeprecate{deprecatedUniqueId} || ", entry UUID " || $xdsDeprecate{deprecatedEntryUuid} || " is now Deprecated. Registry warnings: " || $xdsDeprecate{deprecatedWarnings} || "."

else.log: "Deprecation skipped: the document stays Approved in " || $selectedRegistry || "."

interact.title: Review the upload
interact.instruct: "The CDA was uploaded to DDS and you provided a screenshot showing your system found it. Finish the session to record the result."

success.default: "The CDA was uploaded to DDS and its retrieval in the producer's system was evidenced by a screenshot."

failure.default: "The upload test failed. Open the failed step to distinguish an unreadable CDA, a DDS rejection or a deprecation error."
